Subject: Vendor portal evidence: escrow policy & transient credentials

Hi David —

Hope you're well. We're proceeding with onboarding Redwood to our vendor security portal (Whistic) and had a couple of items that need quick clarification before we complete the profile: 

1) Evidence escrow / possession model: can you confirm how Redwood proves proof-of-possession for ephemeral uploads (e.g., presigned S3, temporary tokens)? Specifically we need the expected TTL for ephemeral credentials and any programmatic attestation you can provide.

2) KMS ownership and key separation: do you use a customer-specific KMS/HSM or a multi-tenant keying model for hosted API customers? A short line on key custody will suffice for our CAIQ mapping.

3) SOC 2 artifacts: please attach the SOC 2 Type II report or a certified summary and the date range covered.

4) Contacts & SLA: who should we list as the long-term evidence steward for renewals/rotation notices? We typically ping that address 60/30/7 days before expiry.

We're on a deadline to finalize the profile this week —  could you reply with the items above and any supporting docs? If easier, a 20–30 minute call would work; I have availability 07/21 11:00–15:00 PDT.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Wu
Vendor Risk Manager
Acme Payments Inc.

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-20T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor portal evidence: escrow policy & transient credentials

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the note. Quick answers below and I attached a short SOC 2 summary and our presign playbook for reference. Full SOC 2 will be shared via an NDA link if needed.

1) Proof-of-possession / ephemeral credentials:
- Presigned S3 uploads: default presign TTL is 15 minutes for onboarding artifacts; we can extend to 1 hour on a per-case basis.
- Short-lived service tokens (for portal ingest) are rotated hourly; audit logs contain ephemeral token issuance events tied to request IDs.
- We can provide a signed statement (PDF) that lists issuance timestamps and presign manifests for a sample window if you need proof-of-possession evidence.

2) KMS ownership:
- Hosted API customers use AWS KMS with a customer-isolated CMK model for enterprise Dedicated/Private customers. For standard hosted accounts we use envelope encryption with Redwood-managed CMKs; customer-sensitive keys for Dedicated/Private can be customer-controlled (BYOK).

3) SOC 2: attached SOC2-TypeII-summary-Redwood.pdf (summary). Full report available behind an NDA.

4) Evidence steward: please list security-portal@redwood.ai for automated rotation notices and compliance@redwood.ai for escalations. For technical clarifications, loop in marissa.cole@redwood.ai.

Proposed next step: 20-minute sync tomorrow (07/21) 11:30 PDT — I just reserved that slot. If that works, Ben will cover S3 ingest mechanics and Marissa will cover encryption/KMS.

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-summary-Redwood.pdf, s3-presign-playbook.md

Thanks,
David
David Kim

Redwood Inference
